title: Preserve explicit policy-admission reader coverage
description: Objective: separate genuine tests of durable POLICY_ALLOWANCE reading from the generic test-world ALLOW precondition before that precondition is removed. Deliverable: policy-specific fixture/test arms that plant only an explicitly labelled historical PolicyEvaluated allowance through the real ledger writer/codec and exercise admission-gate/budget-reader behavior without using the soon-refused caller facts path. NOT in scope: generic activation worlds, the policy resolver/validate change, HUMAN_APPROVAL, or production authority. Verification: focused Vitest over admission-gate-resolver and activation-budget-stage.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK FIRST: at the delivered tree enumerate the five admission-gate-resolver and three activation-budget-stage failures from the null-tier probe, classify which assertions genuinely test reading an existing durable allowance, and prove the real PolicyEvaluated ledger writer/strict reader used for the replacement. If any case is only world setup, leave it for the generic migration rather than relabeling it policy coverage.

A policy-test-only fixture plants an explicitly historical durable PolicyEvaluated ALLOW through the real writer/codec for reader tests; it is not exported to generic activation-world fixtures and cannot be mistaken for a currently sourceable PolicyRiskTier.

The eight measured policy-specific tests reach their original subjects and keep exact code/layer assertions. Tests also prove generic `seedActivationWorld` is not the policy fixture's consumer and that no HUMAN_APPROVAL, tier source, waiver, or caller-fact admission is added.
A durable row comment lists the preserved genuine-policy cases versus cases routed to sibling migrations, with counts and consumer IDs; no production policy/resolver/validate file changes.

`pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` and `pnpm --dir apps/daemon exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/activation/admission-gate-resolver.test.ts src/activation/activation-budget-stage.test.ts` run separately, exit 0, and report nonzero counts.
taskRails: A planted historical decision is reader-test state only; it never claims production can create the decision today.
Do not export the policy-specific fixture into generic world setup.
No HUMAN_APPROVAL, PolicyRiskTier producer, caller facts, or policy production changes.
Assert exact code/layer; preserve foreign work.
